# Rosa × nitidula Besser

First published in Cat. Jard. Bot. Krzemieniec, Suppl. 4: 20, 61, 67 (1815)

This hybrid is accepted

The native range of this hybrid is Canary Islands, NW. Africa, Europe. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome. The hybrid formula is R. canina × R. rubiginosa.
